header: Getting to the Elbkai Congress Centre
subheadline: The venue sits on the north bank at Grosse Elbstrasse 148, about twenty minutes west of the main station. Your delegate badge covers travel on the whole city network for all three days.

routes.description: From Hamburg Hbf take the S1 or S3 to Altona, then bus 111 two stops to Fischmarkt. The entrance faces the water, opposite the ferry pier.
Leave the A7 at Bahrenfeld and follow signs for Altona. The garage under the building has 180 spaces at EUR 4 per hour and can be reserved with your pass.
The S1 leaves Hamburg Airport every ten minutes and reaches Altona in 34 minutes. A taxi to the venue costs around EUR 45 outside the morning rush.
